title: Arc length formula
text: The arc length is the integral of $$\sqrt{\left(\frac{dx}{dt}\right)^2+\left(\frac{dy}{dt}\right)^2}$$ over the interval.

title: Evaluate
text: $$\frac{dx}{dt}=t^2$$ and $$\frac{dy}{dt}=t$$, so the integrand is $$\sqrt{t^4+t^2}=t \sqrt{t^2+1}$$. With $$u=t^2+1$$, the integral is $$\frac{1}{3} u^{\frac{3}{2}}$$ from $$u=1$$ to $$u=2$$, which is $$\frac{2\sqrt{2}-1}{3}$$.
